summary: ATLAS-008 is resolved at the documented architecture level. Cancellation now has explicit outbox reconciliation (docs/recovery-strategy.md §1, line 35); startup includes CANCELLING_REMOTE_MERGE and requires withdrawal confirmation before pausing or releasing locks (§3, lines 117–125). Pause handling also requires confirmed cancellation before entering PAUSED (docs/workflow-state-machine.md §2, line 113). Restart, interrupted cancellation, and pause scenarios are specified in the crash matrix (docs/recovery-strategy.md §5, lines 166–168), and queue support remains disabled until those scenarios pass fault injection (docs/github-integration.md §3, line 65). No open HIGH or CRITICAL finding remains within this verification scope. This verifies the specification, not implementation or test execution.
